summary: Walks a scene-graph tree: for each node, reads its children-list head at this+0x204 and searches the linked list (child next at node+0x10, flag at node+0x14) for a child whose visibility flag has bit 0x80000 set; when such a child is found, registers the current node into the global render list (buffer at dword_8B8F28+336, element size 24, indexed by the counter at dword_8B8F28+332, current node stored at slot+16) and increments the counter. Recurses into the child pointer at this+0x44 when non-null and continues the walk through the sibling pointer at this+0x4C until the sibling chain ends. Called by VertexBufferResourceAllocation.

operations.description: Outer loop walks the scene-graph tree through the sibling chain: each iteration operates on this, then advances to the sibling pointer at this+0x4C, repeating until the sibling pointer is null.
Read the children-list head from this+0x204 (this[129]); if it is null skip the children search and go straight to the recursion check.

Children walk: while the child node's flag field at node+0x14 has bit 0x80000 clear, follow the child's next pointer at node+0x10; the walk stops at the first child with the bit set or when the list is exhausted.

When a visible child is found, register the current node into the global render list: store this at the slot address renderListBuffer + 24 * renderListCounter + 16, then increment the counter at dword_8B8F28+332.
If the child pointer at this+0x44 (this[17]) is non-null, recursively call SceneGraphRenderWalk on it to traverse that subtree.
Advance to the sibling at this+0x4C and repeat the outer loop; the function returns the last computed result once the sibling chain is exhausted.
